integrity: The statement and proof are original computations developed for this result; the motivating published general-polygon theorem and the distinct relative-Chebyshev problem are explicitly credited. Numerical trials supplement, but do not replace, the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim is confined to nondegenerate Euclidean parallelograms and strut points that are not polygon vertices. It neither classifies all quadrilaterals nor settles the consecutive-side conjecture for general polygons. Full archival uniqueness cannot be certified from finite searches.
title: Sharp angle-dependent unit-strut bounds for parallelograms
